verses.english: Linked Discourses 11.14
Chapter Two
Poor

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Rājagaha, in the Bamboo Grove, the squirrels’ feeding ground.
There the Buddha addressed the mendicants,
“Mendicants!”
“Venerable sir,” they replied.
The Buddha said this:

verses.pali: “Bhūtapubbaṁ, bhikkhave, aññataro puriso imasmiṁyeva rājagahe manussadaliddo ahosi manussakapaṇo manussavarāko.
verses.english: “Once upon a time, mendicants, there was a poor person, destitute and pitiful.

verses.pali: So tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye saddhaṁ samādiyi, sīlaṁ samādiyi, sutaṁ samādiyi, cāgaṁ samādiyi, paññaṁ samādiyi.
verses.english: They took up faith, ethics, learning, generosity, and wisdom in the teaching and training proclaimed by the Realized One.

verses.pali: So tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye saddhaṁ samādiyitvā sīlaṁ samādiyitvā sutaṁ samādiyitvā cāgaṁ samādiyitvā paññaṁ samādiyitvā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajji devānaṁ tāvatiṁsānaṁ sahabyataṁ.
verses.english: After undertaking these things, when their body broke up, after death, they were reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm, in the company of the gods of the thirty-three.

verses.pali: So aññe deve atirocati vaṇṇena ceva yasasā ca.
verses.english: There they outshone the other gods in beauty and glory.

verses.pali: Tatra sudaṁ, bhikkhave, devā tāvatiṁsā ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti:
verses.english: But the gods of the thirty-three complained, grumbled, and objected,
‘Oh lord, how incredible, how amazing!

verses.pali: Ayañhi devaputto pubbe manussabhūto samāno manussadaliddo ahosi manussakapaṇo manussavarāko;
verses.english: For when this godling was a human being in their past life they were poor, destitute, and pitiful.

verses.pali: so kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapanno devānaṁ tāvatiṁsānaṁ sahabyataṁ.
verses.english: And when their body broke up, after death, they were reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm, in the company of the gods of the thirty-three.

verses.pali: So aññe deve atirocati vaṇṇena ceva yasasā cā’ti.
verses.english: Here they outshine the other gods in beauty and glory.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo deve tāvatiṁse āmantesi:
verses.english: Then Sakka, lord of gods, addressed the gods of the thirty-three,

verses.pali: ‘mā kho tumhe, mārisā, etassa devaputtassa ujjhāyittha.
verses.english: ‘Good fellows, don’t complain about this god.

verses.pali: Eso kho, mārisā, devaputto pubbe manussabhūto samāno tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye saddhaṁ samādiyi, sīlaṁ samādiyi, sutaṁ samādiyi, cāgaṁ samādiyi, paññaṁ samādiyi.
verses.english: When this godling was a human being in their past life they took up faith, ethics, learning, generosity, and wisdom in the teaching and training proclaimed by the Realized One.

verses.pali: So tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye saddhaṁ samādiyitvā sīlaṁ samādiyitvā sutaṁ samādiyitvā cāgaṁ samādiyitvā paññaṁ samādiyitvā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapanno devānaṁ tāvatiṁsānaṁ sahabyataṁ.
verses.english: After undertaking these things, when their body broke up, after death, they’ve been reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm, in the company of the gods of the thirty-three.

verses.pali: So aññe deve atirocati vaṇṇena ceva yasasā cā’ti.
verses.english: Here they outshine the other gods in beauty and glory.’

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo deve tāvatiṁse anunayamāno tāyaṁ velāyaṁ imā gāthāyo abhāsi:
verses.english: Then Sakka, lord of gods, guiding the gods of the thirty-three, spoke this verse:
‘Whoever has faith in the Realized One,
unwavering and well grounded;
whose ethical conduct is good,
praised and loved by the noble ones;
who has confidence in the Saṅgha,
and correct view:
they’re said to be prosperous,
their life is not in vain.
So let the wise devote themselves
to faith, ethical behaviour,
confidence, and insight into the teaching,
remembering the instructions of the Buddhas.’”
